item.name: Air Artifact
item.cardSummary: Common 2% sky discount earned through flier survival, kills, and travel missions.
item.obtainment: Any qualifying mission can drop this artifact: survive as a Tier 3+ Flier or Glider, kill an age-100 Flier, or travel studs as a Flier or Glider.
item.consumptionRule: Consumed with its paired Storm Artifact when you buy a matching sky Artifact Shop creature.

item.name: Storm Artifact
item.cardSummary: Premium 40% sky discount from Sky Gacha rolls and flier growth or nesting missions.
item.obtainment: Roll the Sky Gacha for a 20% chance per roll, grow a Tier 3+ Flier or Glider to age 100, or nest another player while playing a Flier or Glider.
item.consumptionRule: Consumed with its paired Air Artifact when you buy a matching sky Artifact Shop creature.

item.name: Plant Artifact
item.cardSummary: Common 2% land discount from photovore nesting, eating, and terrestrial travel missions.
item.obtainment: Any qualifying mission can drop this artifact: nest while playing a Tier 3+ Photovore or Photocarnivore, eat food on any creature, or travel studs as a Terrestrial.
item.consumptionRule: Consumed with its paired Earth Artifact when you buy a matching land Artifact Shop creature.

item.name: Earth Artifact
item.cardSummary: Premium 40% land discount from photovore growth, age-100 kills, and injury healing.
item.obtainment: Grow a Tier 3+ Photovore or Photocarnivore to age 100, kill an age-100 Photovore or Photocarnivore, or heal an Injury on any creature.
item.consumptionRule: Consumed with its paired Plant Artifact when you buy a matching land Artifact Shop creature.

item.name: Water Artifact
item.cardSummary: Common 2% sea discount from drinking, aquatic nesting, and aquatic survival missions.
item.obtainment: Drink from a water source, nest another player as an Aquatic, Semi-aquatic, or Semi-aquatic Glider, or survive as one of those aquatic types.
item.consumptionRule: Consumed with its paired Sea Artifact when you buy a matching sea Artifact Shop creature.

item.name: Sea Artifact
item.cardSummary: Premium 40% sea discount from Sea Gacha rolls, aquatic kills, and aquatic growth missions.
item.obtainment: Roll the Sea Gacha, kill any age-100 creature while playing an Aquatic, or grow a Tier 3+ Aquatic, Semi-aquatic, or Semi-aquatic Glider to age 100.
item.consumptionRule: Consumed with its paired Water Artifact when you buy a matching sea Artifact Shop creature.

item.name: Warden Stone
item.cardSummary: Guaranteed common 2% warden discount from food donations at multiple Warden Shrines.
item.obtainment: Guaranteed when you donate the listed food amount at a matching Warden Shrine: 150 (Angelic), 750 (Boreal), 250 (Garra), 50 (Hellion), or 500 (Verdant).
item.consumptionRule: Consumed with its paired Warden's Jewel when you buy a matching warden Artifact Shop creature.

item.name: Warden's Jewel
item.cardSummary: Guaranteed strong 30% warden discount from larger food donations at select Warden Shrines.
item.obtainment: Guaranteed when you donate the listed food amount at a matching Warden Shrine: 2,500 (Ardor), 1,000 (Eigion), or 1,500 (Novus).
item.consumptionRule: Consumed with its paired Warden Stone when you buy a matching warden Artifact Shop creature.

item.name: Fire Artifact
item.cardSummary: Common 2% volcanic discount from volcanic nesting, survival, and Volcano Island feeding.
item.obtainment: Any qualifying mission can drop this artifact: nest as a Volcanic creature, survive as a Volcanic creature, or eat 100 food on Volcano Island.
item.consumptionRule: Consumed with its paired Volcanic Artifact when you buy a matching volcanic Artifact Shop creature.

item.name: Volcanic Artifact
item.cardSummary: Premium 40% volcanic discount from volcanic growth, burn healing, and Volcano Island survival.
item.obtainment: Grow a Tier 3+ Volcanic creature to age 100, heal a burn status effect, or survive on Volcano Island as any creature.
item.consumptionRule: Consumed with its paired Fire Artifact when you buy a matching volcanic Artifact Shop creature.

item.name: Blighted Artifact
item.cardSummary: Strong 5% shadow discount with a rare drop from kills on Shadow Isle.
item.obtainment: Kill another creature on Shadow Isle for a rare chance to receive this artifact.
item.consumptionRule: Consumed with its paired Shadow Artifact when you buy a matching shadow Artifact Shop creature.

item.name: Shadow Artifact
item.cardSummary: Guaranteed strong 30% shadow discount from a 2,500-food donation at the shadow shrine.
item.obtainment: Guaranteed when you donate 2,500 food to the shadow shrine.
item.consumptionRule: Consumed with its paired Blighted Artifact when you buy a matching shadow Artifact Shop creature.
